title: The Lampeter Corpus of Early Modern English Tracts (OTA ota:3193)
notes: 120 English tracts and pamphlets 1640-1740 (~1.19M words), TEI, CC BY-SA 3.0; OTA record ota:3193 answers at https://ota.ox.ac.uk/desc/3193 (the bodleian UI URL is the same record). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Josef Schmied, Claudia Claridge & Rainer Siemund (Chemnitz University of Technology); Oxford Text Archive
